title: Kvarta: a cozier coffee ritual
question: Three warmer versions using your peach #FCEDE3, cream surfaces, softer orange, natural coffee imagery and more rounded visual forms. The typography keeps the character of your reference.

options.label: A warm invitation
options.thesis: A peach-and-cream welcome with a human coffee moment and a compact callback note.
options.viewport: An organic photo window and a friendly headline lead into the real offers and a compact cream callback note.
options.risk: The imagery and shapes need restraint so the simple offer remains easy to scan.

options.label: Your morning table
options.thesis: A coffee pack, ceramic cup and soft morning light turn the product into an everyday ritual.
options.viewport: One warm product still life rests on a soft cream shape; offers and a rounded request panel continue the vertical reading path.
options.risk: The still life should leave enough space for comfortably sized mobile controls.

options.label: From the roast to your cup
options.thesis: A gentle curved path connects Thursday roasting with Friday coffee at home.
options.viewport: A soft flowing composition links the actual weekly steps, with smaller day markers, readable offers and a compact callback panel.
options.risk: The curved visual story must support the schedule rather than become a decorative infographic.
